notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (B2B product discovery) evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search + nightly batch indexing. Primary goal: replace in-house vector pipeline with managed inference to reduce tail latency and operational burden.
Recent timeline:
- 2025-11-12: Intro call (Jordan) — product overview, high level constraints. Customer stressed cost sensitivity and predictable SLAs.
- 2025-11-25: Hosted API demo; ran two sample queries against product catalog — team liked streaming and function-calling demo.
- 2025-12-10: Security questionnaire submitted (SSO + SOC2 required). Maya did a live session to walk through SOC2 controls and KMS support.
- 2026-01-15: POC kickoff (hosted) — ingest ~8M product vectors to Pinecone (customer POC) and run synthetic query load.
- 2026-02-08: Throughput stress test (hosted) — sustained 120 qps with 150ms median token latency for embeddings model (open-embedding-4096). Observed KV/cache warm-up penalty on cold-starts.
- 2026-02-18: Deep-dive call (Fireflies ff-2026-02-18-az1) — discussed Dedicated reserved pool for predictable throughput and lower per-token pricing; Maya presented batching/caching recommendations from Redwood Optimize.
- 2026-02-22: Drive POC report uploaded (drive:/redwood/poc/astrawave_performance_report.pdf) — includes breakdown: token cost vs batch size, quantization options, and fallback model suggestions.
Requirements & constraints observed:
- Workloads: realtime semantic search (search latency SLO <= 200ms for 95th pct), nightly batch re-index of 8M vectors (throughput target: 1.2M vectors/hour during off-peak).
- Vector DB: currently using Pinecone (managed) for search; exploring direct Weaviate/Milvus deployments for on-prem connector. Need robust connector and docs for vector DB write throughput.
- Model preferences: prefer open/quantizable embeddings models (8-bit/4-bit) to save cost; interested in Redwood-provided verified embeddings models.
- Routing/fallback: preference to route to cheaper quantized variant for non-critical queries, fallback to higher-precision model for zero-shot recommender.
- Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, SOC2 attestation or equivalent, KMS integration for key management, audit logging retention 1 year, EU data residency for EU customer subset.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended unit cost reduction of >=30% vs current hosted embeddings spend. Considering Dedicated if cost + SLA math works.
POC findings (high level):
- Hosted API POC OK for MVP and early integration; cold-starts and noisy tails impact 95th pct latency.
- Batching + prefix KV caching reduced per-token CPU footprint by ~22% in POC runs.
- Dedicated pricing proposal shows potential ~35% saving at projected volumes (see pricing deck).
Sales notes / quotes from customer:
- "We need predictable latency for enterprise customers — intermittent slow tails kill demos." — Head of Product
- Finance: "We're open to annual reserved capacity if the savings are guaranteed and SSO integration time is bounded."
Open items & blockers:
- Vector DB connector maturity: customer wants out-of-the-box high-throughput writer to Pinecone/Weaviate; current SDKs need one more integration sprint.
- SSO timeline: internal IT needs 3 weeks for SAML test — blocks moving to Dedicated until completed.
- Budget approval: procurement cycle targets Apr board review; need a pilot discount to accelerate.
Next steps (agreed):
- Redwood to deliver a short-lived Dedicated trial quote and a technical runbook for SAML integration (owner: Maya).
- Customer to run another 48-hour throughput run with larger batches (target 1.2M vectors/hour) and share logs (owner: AstraWave infra).
- Follow-up call scheduled 2026-03-04 to review POC logs and present Dedicated trial proposal.
